Images · 100% Private Client-Side

Photo Best-Shot Finder

Rank burst photos by sharpness, contrast, and clarity heuristics. Zero server uploads — all processing happens directly in your browser.

What it does

Evaluates bursts of similar photographs using Laplacian-style edge contrast, sharpness, and brightness heuristics to rank pictures from sharpest to blurriest. Helps photographers quickly pick the crispest frame from rapid-fire action burst photography.

How to use

  1. Select a batch of burst photos taken in similar lighting from your camera roll.
  2. The heuristic engine evaluates edge gradients across 160x160 sample grids in Canvas.
  3. Inspect the ranked gallery showing the sharpest #1 top-rated photo at the top.
  4. Keep the highest-scoring crisp photographs and safely delete blurry candidate shots.

Limits & Considerations

Uses edge-contrast heuristics for sharpness estimation. Does not evaluate aesthetic artistic composition or facial expression smiles.

Privacy & Security

Pixel data is analyzed inside local Canvas memory buffers without external API calls or machine learning cloud server uploads.
